batch.panelHint: Click a document to open it in the editor. What is missing comes first.

step1.title: 1 · Upload the PDFs
step1.text: All the documents you want to work on. You can add more or remove some.

step2.title: 2 · Upload the templates (JSON)
step2.text: Optional. One JSON per PDF with the same name (invoice.json for invoice.pdf). Without a template the PDF starts with no annotations.
step2.pastePlaceholder: Paste the templates here: an array, one document or several in a row (for example, what you extract from Mongo).
step2.pasteHint: They are matched by the pdfName field (or name, fileName, type). Mongo fields are ignored; only pages matters.
step2.pasteTooBig: The pasted text is over 5 MB.

versionsDrop.title: New versions (B)
versionsDrop.text: Got redesigned PDFs? Drop them here and they are paired by name with each PDF in the batch.
versionsDrop.addedText: The rest have no B version. You can drop more here.
versionsDrop.unpairedText: They do not match any PDF in the batch: assign them by hand or discard them.

resume.title: Saved batch
resume.text: You have a batch of {{count}} PDFs in progress.

doc.replaceConfirm: Replace this PDF with “{{name}}”? Annotations are kept.

a.title: ① Template of the original (A)
a.hint: The annotations of the original PDF. They are the base to edit this PDF or the reference for the new version.
a.replacesNote: Replaces the current annotations (can be undone).

error.tooBig: The JSON is larger than 5 MB.
error.noPages: No pages with fields were found in that JSON.

b.title: ② New version of the PDF (B)
b.hint: If there is a redesigned PDF, add it and you edit on it with A as a reference.
b.removeConfirm: Remove version B? Its annotations are lost and the original PDF is edited again with its template.

doc.noTemplateNote: No template: you can load the original’s or add a new version in Document.

adjust.title: Adjust by texts

none.title: There are no matching texts in A and B.
none.text: The text may have changed. No offset is guessed.

noText.title: A PDF has no text to read.
noText.text: It looks scanned, so it cannot be adjusted by texts.

adjust.summary: {{anchors}} matching texts in A and B · {{fields}} fields from A
adjust.skipped: {{count}} fields B already has are kept.
adjust.untouched: B has not been changed yet.
adjust.few: Only {{count}} texts in common: the proposal is approximate, review the fields.
adjust.noShift: no texts to work it out
adjust.undoHint: One history step: Ctrl+Z undoes it. Unticked fields are copied without moving.
adjust.strip: {{anchors}} matching texts · {{fields}} fields proposed ({{near}} by nearby text, {{estimated}} estimated).
adjust.holdHint: Hold P to see the original

card.typical: No texts nearby: typical shift of the page.

mode.label: Show

samples.title: Sample values
samples.description: What each type paints when the field has no «value» and no test data. Keeps a long mapping from breaking the layout.
samples.note: Saved in this browser and shared by all your templates. Shown in the preview and in the exported PDF.

testData.title: Test data
testData.description: Paste a real or mock JSON. Each mapField (holder[0].fullname) is looked up in it and its value is painted.
testData.resolvedHint: Fields without data use their sample value.
testData.shapeError: The test JSON must be an object or a list.
testData.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
testData.readFailed: The file could not be read.
testData.empty: No test data: sample values are used.

origin.mapHint: Map view paints the field name, so there is no origin to show.
origin.noneResolved: No mapField matches the test data.

exportSamples.title: {{count}} fields would paint a sample value
exportSamples.lead: These fields have no «value» and no test data. What should the PDF contain?
exportSamples.optMapHint: As before: the value or the mapField text is stamped.
exportSamples.optSampleHint: The sample for the type is stamped (XXXXX, X, 00000).
exportSamples.remember: Remember my choice in this session

panel.title: Connection to the AI
panel.checking: Looking for the helper and the installed programs.
panel.limits: Your subscription limits apply, not paid tokens.
panel.noCli: I cannot find “{{cmd}}” on this computer. Install it, sign in once (type its name in a terminal) and check again.
panel.send: Sent to your AI: the pages of A and B as images, their texts and the fields of template A (name and position). Never the original PDFs.

offline.title: I cannot find the helper.
offline.text: The AI needs a small program on your computer. Start it and check again.
offline.step1: Start the app with the command above (close the current one).
offline.step2: If you already did, make sure the terminal is still open.

model.opus: Opus · uses up your limit sooner
model.copilotHint: Each request counts against your “premium requests” by model. Type a specific one if your administrator says so.
model.sonnetHint: Sonnet: enough to place fields and light on your limit.

menu.title: Copy and adapt with AI
menu.text: Understands that a field moves or changes page. Uses your {{provider}}. A few seconds per PDF.

loading.title: {{provider}} is comparing A and B…
loading.hint: You can keep editing; B is not touched until you apply.

offline.title: The helper does not answer.
offline.text: Is the terminal with npm run start:ia still open?

limit.title: Subscription limit.
limit.text: {{provider}} has reached your subscription limit. It renews at {{reset}}. What was already proposed is kept.

timeout.title: The AI did not answer in time.

bad_response.title: The answer is not understood.
bad_response.text: We tried once more without success.

cli_error.title: The AI returned an error.
cli_error.text: Check the detail and that you are still signed in.

missing.title: Program not found.
missing.text: Install it and sign in once.

busy.title: The helper is busy.
busy.text: Another request is running; wait for it to finish.

error.title: The proposal could not be requested.

empty.title: No changes to apply.
empty.text: The AI did not place any field.

review.title: AI proposal ({{provider}})
review.untouched: B has not been modified yet.
review.listHint: Low-confidence or unplaced fields are not applied until you tick them.

consent.title: You are about to send pages to {{provider}}
consent.intro: To compare A and B, the helper gives your {{provider}}:
consent.pages: The pages of A and B as images and their texts.
consent.fields: The fields of template A (position and name).
consent.not: It does not send the original PDFs. Your {{provider}} session processes them under its own terms. Use only PDFs you may send.
consent.remember: Do not warn again on this computer

ai.notice: {{count}} fields proposed by the AI · B unchanged
